quiz.question: Which Wi-Fi security should you pick on a new router?
options: WPA3, or WPA2 if a device can't use it
quiz.answer_text: WPA3, or WPA2 if a device can't use it
quiz.why: WPA3 is the current standard and WPA2 is the fallback. WEP is broken, and open networks have no encryption.
